input: Draft a business card design for my freelance brand

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Business Card for Your Freelance Brand
gold.taskDescription: Create a business card design that represents the user's freelance brand identity.

questions.title: What type of freelance work do you do?
questions.description: Understanding the user's field (e.g., photography, copywriting, web development) shapes the tone and content of the card.

questions.title: Do you already have a brand name or logo?
questions.description: Knowing whether a brand name or logo exists determines how much identity work needs to happen before design begins.

questions.title: Which contact details should appear on the card?
questions.description: The user needs to specify which details to include, such as phone, email, website, or social handles.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred color palette in mind?
questions.description: A specific color direction helps establish the visual style and ensures brand consistency.

questions.title: What mood or style should the design convey?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user wants minimal, bold, elegant, or playful guides all design decisions.

questions.title: Will you print this card or use it digitally?
questions.description: Print versus digital use affects dimensions, resolution, file format, and finish considerations.

questions.title: Which tool should be used to create the design?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred tool, such as Canva, Adobe Illustrator, or Figma, determines the format and approach for execution.
